title: A lesson that still plays when the connection does not
voiceNote: Narration is an eSpeak device voice so the lesson plays with no API key. Captions are the text to trust. A Hasab voice can replace the audio when a key is set.

figure.alt: A navy phone on a paper background, with an English and Amharic caption under the screen.
figure.long: A simple drawing, not a photograph. A tall rounded rectangle stands in for a phone. Inside it, a smaller rectangle is the screen. Under the phone, two lines of caption text are suggested by a black bar and a shorter bar. Nothing in the drawing depends on colour alone: the phone has a dark outline and the caption bars are separate shapes.

segments.en: Hana opens her lesson on a phone in Addis Ababa.
segments.am: ሃና ትምህርቷን በአዲስ አበባ በስልኳ ትከፍታለች።
segments.ad: A phone is drawn on a paper-coloured screen, with a short caption under it.

segments.en: She needs English and Amharic captions she can make larger.
segments.am: የእንግሊዝኛ እና የአማርኛ ጽሑፍ መግለጫዎችን ማተለቅ ትፈልጋለች።
segments.ad: The caption bar grows taller. The letters are yellow on a black band.

segments.en: A sign window can move and grow, so Ethiopian Sign Language sits where she needs it.
segments.am: የምልክት መስኮቱን ማንቀሳቀስና ማተለቅ ትችላለች። የኢትዮጵያ የምልክት ቋንቋ የምትፈልገውን ቦታ ይይዛል።
segments.ad: A second window lifts off the phone. It is labelled Ethiopian Sign Language.

segments.en: Audio description says what the picture is doing, for a learner who cannot see it.
segments.am: የድምጽ መግለጫ ሥዕሉ ምን እንደሚያደርግ ይናገራል። ለማያየው ተማሪ ነው።
segments.ad: A round speaker icon appears beside the phone.

segments.en: When the network is slow she keeps a small pack: sound, text, and a light page.
segments.am: ኔትወርኩ ሲዘገይ ትንሽ ጥቅል ታስቀምጣለች። ድምጽ፣ ጽሑፍ፣ እና ቀላል ገጽ።
segments.ad: The phone is replaced by a short stack of pages and a sound file.

segments.en: The lesson on this page is the same one, with the network or without it.
segments.am: በዚህ ገጽ ላይ ያለው ትምህርት አንድ ነው። ኔትወርክ ቢኖርም ባይኖርም።
segments.ad: The stack of pages stays in the centre of the screen.

chat.speaker: Facilitator
chat.text: We are watching together. Captions are on.

chat.speaker: Hana
chat.text: Please make the Amharic text larger.

chat.speaker: Facilitator
chat.text: Move the sign window if it covers the caption.

chat.speaker: Yonas
chat.text: I will turn on audio description.

chat.speaker: Hana
chat.text: I am saving the small pack before the network drops.

chat.speaker: Facilitator
chat.text: The text page matches what you just heard.
